name: Common helpers (devcontainer-features)
description: Shared helpers used by this collection's Features: dcf-persist (installed, also for a repo's own post-create scripts), which makes a tool's state directory (a named volume or a bind mount) usable by the remote user and reports what backs it; and dcf-curl.sh, the download helper every installer sources so each download retries every error.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).
